gcc.setup:
%patch %(pkgdir)/perf/increase-vectorize-cost-model-to-cheap.patch
%patch %(pkgdir)/perf/use-highest-optimize-value.patch
%patch %(pkgdir)/aerynos/0001-Use-modern-linker-locations-for-Serpent-OS.patch
%patch %(pkgdir)/aerynos/0001-Install-libraries-into-lib-rather-than-lib64.patch
%patch %(pkgdir)/aerynos/0001-Downstream-Don-t-run-fixincludes-during-install.patch
%patch %(pkgdir)/aerynos/disable-rpath.patch

function gcc_configure() {
    ../configure \
        --build=%(host_platform) \
        --host=%(host_platform) \
        --prefix=/usr \
        --libdir=%(libdir) \
        --libexecdir=%(libdir) \
        --disable-libssp \
        --enable-cet \
        --enable-checking=release \
        --enable-default-pie \
        --enable-default-ssp \
        --enable-gnu-indirect-function \
        --enable-host-bind-now \
        --enable-host-pie \
        --enable-link-serialization \
        --enable-linker-build-id \
        --enable-multilib \
        --enable-plugin \
        --enable-shared \
        --enable-threads=yes \
        --with-arch=%(march) \
        --with-arch_32=%(march) \
        --with-bugurl='https://github.com/AerynOS/recipes/issues' \
        --with-build-config=${_build_config} \
        --with-gcc-major-version-only \
        --with-gxx-libcxx-include-dir=/usr/include/c++/v1 \
        --with-isl \
        --with-linker-hash-style=gnu \
        --with-multilib-list=m32,m64 \
        --with-pkgversion="AerynOS" \
        --with-system-zlib \
        --with-tune=%(mtune) \
        --with-tune_32=%(mtune) \
        "$@"
}

mkdir gcc_build libgccjit_build

pushd gcc_build
gcc_configure \
    --enable-bootstrap \
    --enable-languages=c,c++,cobol,fortran,rust
popd

# Build libgccjit separately to avoid building all compilers with enable-host-shared which has a performance penalty
# I didn't test that but both Arch and Fedora has the same note in their repos
# TODO: Test that
pushd libgccjit_build
gcc_configure \
    --disable-bootstrap \
    --enable-host-shared \
    --enable-languages=jit \
    --enable-libgdiagnostics
popd
gcc.install:
%make_install -C gcc_build

# libgccjit
DESTDIR="%(installroot)" %make -C gcc_build/gcc jit.install-common jit.install-info

# libgdiagnostics
DESTDIR="%(installroot)" %make -C libgccjit_build/gcc install-libgdiagnostics

# Info files
for lib in libgomp libitm libquadmath; do
    DESTDIR="%(installroot)" %make -C gcc_build/%(host_platform)/${lib} install-info
done

# bfd needs to be able to find the LTO plugin
major_version=$(echo %(version) | cut -d. -f1)
%install_dir %(installroot)/%(libdir)/bfd-plugins
ln -srfv %(installroot)/%(libdir)/gcc/%(build_platform)/${major_version}/liblto_plugin.so %(installroot)/%(libdir)/bfd-plugins/liblto_plugin.so

# gdb needs to autoload some files, maybe lldb piggy backs off this?
%install_dir %(installroot)/%(datadir)/gdb/auto-load/%(libdir)
%install_dir %(installroot)/%(datadir)/gdb/auto-load/%(libdir)32
mv %(installroot)/%(libdir)/libstdc++.so.*-gdb.py %(installroot)/%(datadir)/gdb/auto-load/%(libdir)/.
mv %(installroot)/%(libdir)32/libstdc++.so.*-gdb.py %(installroot)/%(datadir)/gdb/auto-load/%(libdir)32/.
%python_compile

# Causes file conflicts
rm -rv %(installroot)%(datadir)/info/dir

# Clang provides c++ on Aeryn
rm -v %(installroot)%(bindir)/c++ %(installroot)%(bindir)/%(host_platform)-c++

# Make x86_64-solus-linux a target alias of x86_64-aerynos-linux, and add compat targets for common x86 targets
pushd %(installroot)/%(bindir)
for compat in x86_64-solus-linux x86_64-linux-gnu x86_64-pc-linux-gnu; do
    for i in g++ gcc gcc-${major_version} gcc-ar gcc-nm gcc-ranlib gccrs gfortran ; do
        ln -sv %(host_platform)-${i} ${compat}-${i}
    done
    ln -srv %(installroot)/usr/include/c++/${major_version}/%(host_platform) %(installroot)/usr/include/c++/${major_version}/${compat}
    ln -srv %(installroot)/usr/lib/gcc/%(host_platform) %(installroot)/usr/lib/gcc/${compat}
done
popd

# TODO: Remove once we can remove gcc-devel and gcc-32bit-devel from the index
mkdir -p %(installroot)/usr/share/doc/replace/
touch %(installroot)/usr/share/doc/replace/gcc{,-32bit}-devel %(installroot)/usr/share/doc/replace/g++-32bit
touch %(installroot)/usr/share/doc/replace/libatomic{,-32bit}-static
gcc.environment:
# Change this to 1 if you want a much faster (but slower at runtime) build
# This is useful when updating to a new version or rebootstrapping the GCC toolchain
_fast_build=0

_build_config="bootstrap-lto-lean"
_build_step="profiledbootstrap"
if [ $_fast_build -eq 1 ]; then
    _build_config="bootstrap-O1"
    _build_step="bootstrap2-lean"
fi

glibc.setup:
%patch %(pkgdir)/perf/0001-Remove-RELR-dependency-check.patch
%patch %(pkgdir)/aerynos/0001-sysdeps-Add-support-for-default-directories.patch
%patch %(pkgdir)/aerynos/0001-Force-correct-RTLDLIST-for-ldd.patch
%patch %(pkgdir)/aerynos/0001-Compress-charmaps-with-zstd.patch
%patch %(pkgdir)/aerynos/0001-downstream-Update-default-PATH.patch
%patch %(pkgdir)/stateless/make-hosts-file-stateless.patch
%patch %(pkgdir)/stateless/Support-fallback-stateless-shells-path.patch
%patch %(pkgdir)/stateless/Use-a-stateless-ld.so.conf.patch
%patch %(pkgdir)/stateless/0001-Stateless-nsswitch.conf.patch
%patch %(pkgdir)/stateless/ld-so-cache-in-var.patch

mkdir build && cd build
echo "LD_SO_CACHE=/var/cache/ldconfig/ld.so.cache" >> configparms
echo "slibdir=%(libdir)" >> configparms
echo "rtlddir=%(libdir)" >> configparms
echo "sbindir=%(sbindir)" >> configparms
echo "rootsbindir=%(sbindir)" >> configparms
# Note this deliberately excludes libsuffix and is not an error
echo "complocaledir=/usr/lib/locale" >> configparms

# CET is strict (cet_elf_property): IBT/SHSTK are enabled for modules that
# advertise them, and dlopen() of a non-CET library fails while SHSTK is
# active. All our 64-bit packages are built with -fcf-protection; the 32-bit
# profile stays --disable-cet.
# SFrame is only supported on x86_64/aarch64 (not the 32-bit target)
../configure \
    $COMMON_GLIBC_OPTIONS \
    --enable-cet \
    --enable-sframe
glibc.install:
%make_install build DESTDIR="%(installroot)" -C build

# Make gconv cache
LD_LIBRARY_PATH=%(installroot)/%(libdir) %(installroot)/%(libdir)/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2 %(installroot)/usr/sbin/iconvconfig --prefix=%(installroot)

%make localedata/install-locale-files DESTDIR="%(installroot)" -C build

# We don't support nss_db/hesiod currently
rm -v %(installroot)/%(bindir)/makedb \
      %(installroot)/%(libdir)/libnss_db.so* \
      %(installroot)/%(libdir)/libnss_hesiod.so* \
      %(installroot)/var/db/Makefile
rmdir -v %(installroot)/var/db %(installroot)/var

# Stateless: Remove obsolete rpc
rm -v %(installroot)/etc/rpc
rmdir -v %(installroot)/etc

%install_file %(pkgdir)/ld.so.conf  %(installroot)/%(vendordir)/ld.so.conf
%install_dir %(installroot)/%(vendordir)/ld.so.conf.d
# Vendor NSS default used when /etc/nsswitch.conf is absent; keep in sync with systemd's /usr/share/factory/etc/nsswitch.conf
%install_file %(pkgdir)/nsswitch.conf %(installroot)/%(vendordir)/nsswitch.conf
# Vendor hosts default read by the stateless nss_files fallback
%install_file %(pkgdir)/hosts %(installroot)/%(vendordir)/hosts
%install_file %(pkgdir)/glibc_ldconfig.yaml %(installroot)/usr/share/moss/triggers/sys.d/glibc_ldconfig.yaml


# Stateless: We need these directories to exist without including them
%tmpfiles "# Create stateless directories"
%tmpfiles "d /etc/ld.so.conf.d 0755 - - -"
%tmpfiles "d /var/cache/ldconfig 0755 - - -"
%tmpfiles "d /var/db 0755 - - -"
glibc.environment:
# --enable-kernel tracks the fourth-most-recent LTS kernel (kernel.org longterm)
# TODO: systemtap support (--enable-systemtap and sys/sdt.h) once a systemtap package exists
export COMMON_GLIBC_OPTIONS="\

        --disable-build-nscd \

        --enable-fortify-source \

to applications using gvfs.

This package provides support for reading and writing files on
MTP based devices (Media Transfer Protocol) to applications using gvfs.
